title: INSPECT TALLYING — count occurrences with positional BEFORE/AFTER qualifiers
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. COUNT-DOTS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EMAIL    PIC X(80).
       01  WS-DOT-COUNT PIC 9(3).
      *> Counts the number of '.' characters in WS-EMAIL. The
      *> BEFORE INITIAL '@' restricts the tally to the local part of
      *> the email -- INSPECT scans left-to-right and stops at the
      *> first '@'. A Java port using String.chars().filter must
      *> mirror the positional restriction or count too many.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       COUNT.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DOT-COUNT
           INSPECT WS-EMAIL TALLYING WS-DOT-COUNT
              FOR ALL '.' BEFORE INITIAL '@'.
           STOP RUN.
notes: INSPECT TALLYING with positional qualifiers is more powerful than a simple count — it scans with a state machine. The spec must capture the BEFORE/AFTER condition so the rewrite preserves the substring-scoped count.
